title: Now you see it.
note: A glass knot turning on vibrant green, only visible where it bends the type behind it.
process: Code only, no generative model. [[Claude Code]] set the type in [[Google Fonts]] Fraunces, soft and wonky, on a 12 column grid in [[Canvas]], then built a torus knot in [[WebGL]] that refracts that type with a little dispersion and almost no edge, so the glass only shows through the letters. Grain and paper fibre overlays give the green its depth, and [[FFmpeg]] turned the 8 second turn into a loop.
keywords: some text to anchor the design
